note: Decision paths the step vocabulary cannot reach, recorded per card so a shard cannot be reported done over them. Hand-authored: unlike specs/trusted.json and specs/quarantine.json, nothing generates this file. tools/spec/coverage.py reads it, prints it beside the uncovered list, and refuses the `--done` verdict for any pack holding an open entry. unit_test/test_spec_coverage.py checks the shape and that the feature file named by each entry exists and tags the card.
why_a_file_and_not_a_comment: Three core-set spec files carried a gap like this as prose in their header, which is a note and not a record: `python -m tools.spec.coverage --pack core` counted every one of those cards as covered and reported nothing missing. A missed population does not look like a bug, it looks like a smaller universe (MARVEL-16). An entry here is a debt, never a discount -- it does not raise coverage and it does not lower a tier's plan.
how_to_close_one: Delete the entry. It is not a permanent judgement: 01040b T'Challa, 01116a Underground Distribution and 01137a The Crimson Cowl were all in this shape until `my deck at setup is` / `the encounter deck at setup is` reached them (MARVEL-121), and 01096 Rhino III was recorded as unreachable on a claim that turned out to be false. An entry that has stopped being true is worse than no entry, so check before adding and check again before trusting.

unreachable.path: the loop in "deal 1 damage to each hero"
unreachable.why: `I am in hero form` speaks for seat 1 only and the catalogue has no per-seat form of it, so on a two-player board the second hero is an alter-ego and the loop measures the same one hero. A two-player scenario reads identically to the solo one, which is a scenario that proves nothing rather than one that fails.
unreachable.blocked_by: no `player <n> is in hero form` step

unreachable.path: the loop in "When Revealed: Stun each hero"
unreachable.why: Same cause as 01103, recorded from the other side. The card's own file says so: a second player cannot distinguish the loop from a single resolution, because there is no step that puts another player into hero form.
unreachable.blocked_by: no `player <n> is in hero form` step
